notes: Paper sets world-leading limits on ALP-photon coupling (c_gamma/Lambda, GeV^-1) from a bump hunt of a published PrimEx carbon-target diphoton mass spectrum (Fig. S2), and separately on ALP-gluon coupling (c_g/Lambda) from GlueX data (Fig. S4). The requested/new observed AxionPhoton limit spans ~0.11-0.15 GeV with best (world-leading) sensitivity near 115 and 160 MeV; values digitized approximately from Fig. S2 with the text anchor Lambda~0.6 TeV (c_gamma/Lambda~1.7e-3) at m_a=0.11 GeV. y-axis c_gamma/Lambda equals g_agamma for c_gamma=1. Fig. 2 also contains PrimEx/GlueX projections which are NOT included here (those are projections). 95% CL.
